visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an outdoor urban park with lush green trees and blurred street traffic in the background. A young woman, Forty, wearing a white t-shirt and glasses, sits on a wooden bench. Two male hosts, one in a black t-shirt and another in a grey sweatshirt and green cap, approach her. The lighting is natural and bright, typical of an overcast day. (2) The camera moves closer as the group begins rummaging through Forty's black backpack. The hosts wear white gloves to handle items. They pull out a comb, pens, and a pink envelope marked with the word 'LOVE'. Forty smiles and reacts with animated facial expressions while the hosts look curious. (3) Forty holds up a crumpled white piece of paper containing large printed text about the '2025 New Taipei Street School' event. She gestures excitedly with her hands while speaking to the camera. The host in the black t-shirt stands beside her, looking at the camera with a wide grin. (4) A brief flashback cutaway shows Forty in a different setting, a domestic kitchen filled with seasoning bottles and cooking equipment. She is seen interacting with others in a more casual, indoor environment with warm lighting. This scene is framed with a border and text at the top. (5) The video returns to the outdoor interview where Forty continues her enthusiastic promotion. She points at the paper and talks about various activities like dancing and graffiti. The scene is filled with colorful text overlays and variety-show style captions that pop up frequently.

The audio ends with a high-energy vocal wrap-up and a final musical stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Interview -> Surprise Object Reveal -> Event Promotion -> Direct Appeal
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a casual street interview and backpack unboxing format to reveal a promotional flyer for the '2025 New Taipei Street School' event. It aims to inform and excite potential attendees about the event's diverse activities—including concerts, graffiti workshops, and dance classes—through a humorous and high-energy social-media delivery.
